subject: Quick site cleanup for Handy Bro's
body:
Hi Handy Bro's team,

I’m a Milwaukee-based developer. I ran a quick scan of your site and noticed a few fixable basics: the page title appears as "Home", I did not see a useful meta description, and an FAQ section could answer timing, pricing, service area, and what happens after contact.

I’m doing $150 website repair passes: mobile spacing, contact buttons, service-copy cleanup, broken links, image speed, and basic SEO fixes.

I also made a free self-check page here if you want to score it yourself: https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/audit.html
